title.narrative: Share-Net Bangladesh

description.narrative: Share-Net Bangladesh is the country hub of Share-Net International, a Knowledge Platform focusing on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR). Share-Net Bangladesh is the first of Share-Net International’s country hub, drawing on the years of experiences and interventions by practitioners, researchers, and policymakers in the field of sexual reproductive health, especially placing SRHR at the centre of human rights. Share-Net Bangladesh aims to bring together the Communities of Practice (CoP) that consist of social and medical researchers, development practitioners, health workers, government officials and legal experts to engage with one another to find solutions and take critical issues forward. Share-Net Bangladesh is hosted by RedOrange Media and Communications. Priorities of Share-Net Bangladesh: * Promote interaction between the national, international, sustainable and empowered community of practice and encourage them to share learning. * To apply the knowledge to evidence-informed SRHR programs, policies and practices. * Enable the members and the strategic partners to connect, discuss, share, translate and jointly operate this knowledge network on SRHR. * Ensure the accessibility of the policymakers, practitioners and researchers to the knowledge platform and enable them to address the relevant knowledge gaps on SRHR scientifically, politically and practically

comment.narrative: # Ms. Mushfiqua Zaman Satiar, Senior Policy Adviser- SRHR and Gender, SCS Partnership Coordinator and Youth Focal at the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands has been in good liaison with Share-Net Bangladesh. In 2022, Ms Mushfiqua was included in the Steering Committee in an advisory role in early 2022, she was present in 3 of the 4 steering committee meetings. She has been providing valuable insights on the SRHR situation in the country and based on her suggestion the 2022 activities were aligned. Ms Mushfiqua re-connected Share-Net Bangladesh team with different Dutch funded partnerships and Share-Net Bangladesh used these partnerships to align the annual activities in a coherent way so the impact of collective work is greater. #Apart from this, Ms Mushfiqua has regular monthly meetings with Share-Net Bangladesh to guide the secretariat in a strategic way. 5 monthly meetings took place from August 2022 till December 2022 with Ms Mushfiqua.# Veronika Flegar, First Secretary at the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands to Bangladesh was invited as a special guest at the 7th Annual Knowledge Fair 2022 and provided her valuable feedback at the Knowledge Fair on the knowledge Fair theme �Access to Information on SRHR�. Ms Mushfiqua also joined the knowledge fair as a guest speaker. #Share-Net was represented at the OKP partners programme that was held on 8th December 2022 in presence of MoFA representative Jacqueline B. Tellings Broerse, Senior Policy Advisor, Social Development Department, Civil Society and Education Division, Ministry of Forign Affairs, The Kingdom of the Netherlands.#Arnob Chakrabarty, Jannatul Munia and Kimberley Meijers, as Share-Net Bangladesh and Share-Net International members, delivered a presentation on Share-Net Bangladesh and its mission and activities with SRHR at the Dutch Embassy in Bangladesh that was held on 27th September 2022.
